Looking at panel A (males, indicated by the male symbol), the y‑axis shows the relative change in population distance to baseline across stimulus exposure. At 100% of stimulus exposure, the magenta/purple curve (Rat bedding) remains the highest (≈0.22–0.25), while the Female, Male, and Pups curves have dropped to lower values (≈0.15–0.20) and the baseline is lowest. Thus the rat bedding stimulus shows the greatest relative change in population distance at 100% exposure.

[ANSWER]D[/ANSWER]
